name: Guisarmiere
description:
You gain martial training in great polearms.

While wielding any polearm, you have the following abilities:

  • You may use a half action to make a melee attack with the butt end. The damage die for this attack is a d4. You may spend 1 MP to upgrade the damage die for one butt attack to a d6.

  • Any time you attack with a polearm - not the butt end - and you roll max damage, you may spend 1 MP to inflict Injury.

Describe how you wield your polearm.

improvements.name: Takedown
improvements.description: Whenever you roll max damage for an attack made with either end of a polearm, you may roll Strength vs Dexterity against the creature you hit. On a win, the creature is knocked prone.

improvements.name: Brace For Impact
improvements.description:
While wielding a polearm two-handed, you may spend an action to brace it against the ground. For the next round, as long as you don't move from your position:

  • You gain +WITS Defense.

  • The first time a creature makes a melee attack against you, roll Strength vs Dexterity instead of rolling engagement. On a win, you land a hit with your polearm and it deals max damage.

improvements.name: Polearm Master
improvements.description: While wielding a polearm two-handed, if you make an opportunity attack and land a hit, the creature's movement is stopped and they cannot move further this turn.
